summary: Updated implementation plan for the pure GitHub Action package (Argon Review): removed the Express/React web workbench, updated fork PR handling to use core.warning + core.summary without posting PR comments, added OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR authorization check for /review issue_comment triggers, added escaping for closing </UNTRUSTED_PR_DIFF> tags in diffs, and centralized the model ID in DEFAULT_GEMINI_MODEL.
